title: The display tests start whenever play does
summary: The diagonal and snake tests are no longer refused busy while the board reads its animations after a start or while an upload is open, since play is taken then and the tests use playback's own decoder; an upload already open goes on to its end under a test, the mutations a test refuses today stay refused, and mapping set no longer waits for the reading after a start. Core only; firmware images rebuilt; no command, reply or error change.
